name: First Contact Resolution (FCR)
description: Measures the percentage of incoming customer interactions resolved on the initial contact without requiring transfers, escalations, or follow-up continuation sessions.
business_rules: An interaction achieves FCR when status is closed or resolved, with no outgoing CONTINUES relationship and no Transfer record.
Conversations with (:Conversation)-[:CONTINUES]->() indicate repeat contacts or unaddressed root causes.
Exclude interactions abandoned or disconnected before agent assignment.
cypher_template: MATCH (c:Conversation) WHERE c.status IN ["resolved", "closed"] OPTIONAL MATCH (c)-[:CONTINUES]->(next:Conversation) WITH c, count(next) AS continuations RETURN count(c) AS total_resolved, sum(CASE WHEN continuations = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fcr_count, round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN continuations = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / count(c), 1) AS fcr_rate_pct
diagnostic_template: MATCH (c:Conversation) WHERE c.created_at >= datetime() AND c.created_at < datetime() AND c.status IN ["resolved", "closed"] OPTIONAL MATCH (c)-[:CONTINUES]->(next:Conversation) WITH c.channel AS dimension, sum(CASE WHEN c.created_at >= datetime() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS curr_total, sum(CASE WHEN c.created_at >= datetime() AND next IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS curr_fcr, sum(CASE WHEN c.created_at < datetime() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS prev_total, sum(CASE WHEN c.created_at < datetime() AND next IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS prev_fcr RETURN dimension AS channel, curr_total, curr_fcr, CASE WHEN curr_total > 0 THEN round(100.0 * curr_fcr / curr_total, 1) ELSE 0.0 END AS current_fcr_pct, prev_total, prev_fcr, CASE WHEN prev_total > 0 THEN round(100.0 * prev_fcr / prev_total, 1) ELSE 0.0 END AS previous_fcr_pct, curr_total - prev_total AS volume_delta ORDER BY curr_total DESC

name: Average Handle Time (AHT)
description: Calculates the average duration from conversation start to end. Must ALWAYS be segmented by channel because synchronous channels differ drastically from asynchronous channels.
business_rules: Handle time duration is computed in seconds using duration.between(c.created_at, c.ended_at).seconds.
Always group by c.channel. Never pool asynchronous email (~1.5 hours) with live voice calls (~23 min) or webchat (~12 min).
Exclude records where ended_at is null.
cypher_template: MATCH (c:Conversation) WHERE c.created_at IS NOT NULL AND c.ended_at IS NOT NULL RETURN c.channel AS channel, count(c) AS total_conversations, round(avg(duration.between(c.created_at, c.ended_at).seconds), 1) AS avg_handle_time_sec, min(duration.between(c.created_at, c.ended_at).seconds) AS min_sec, max(duration.between(c.created_at, c.ended_at).seconds) AS max_sec ORDER BY total_conversations DESC
diagnostic_template: MATCH (c:Conversation) WHERE c.created_at >= datetime() AND c.created_at < datetime() AND c.ended_at IS NOT NULL WITH c.channel AS dimension, [x IN collect(CASE WHEN c.created_at >= datetime() THEN duration.between(c.created_at, c.ended_at).seconds ELSE NULL END) WHERE x IS NOT NULL] AS curr_durs, [x IN collect(CASE WHEN c.created_at < datetime() THEN duration.between(c.created_at, c.ended_at).seconds ELSE NULL END) WHERE x IS NOT NULL] AS prev_durs RETURN dimension AS channel, size(curr_durs) AS current_volume, CASE WHEN size(curr_durs) > 0 THEN round(reduce(s = 0.0, d IN curr_durs | s + d) / size(curr_durs), 1) ELSE 0.0 END AS current_aht_sec, size(prev_durs) AS previous_volume, CASE WHEN size(prev_durs) > 0 THEN round(reduce(s = 0.0, d IN prev_durs | s + d) / size(prev_durs), 1) ELSE 0.0 END AS previous_aht_sec, size(curr_durs) - size(prev_durs) AS volume_delta ORDER BY current_volume DESC

name: Service Level (SLA Adherence)
description: Percentage of interactions answered or resolved within defined SLA target thresholds.
business_rules: Tracked on c.sla_status: within_sla, breached, not_started.
First response breach occurs when first_agent_response_at > first_response_due_at.
Resolution breach occurs when resolved_at > resolution_due_at.
cypher_template: MATCH (c:Conversation) WHERE c.sla_status IS NOT NULL RETURN c.sla_status AS sla_status, c.channel AS channel, count(c) AS total_count ORDER BY total_count DESC
diagnostic_template: MATCH (c:Conversation) WHERE c.created_at >= datetime() AND c.created_at < datetime() AND c.sla_status IS NOT NULL WITH c.sla_status + " (" + c.channel + ")" AS dimension, sum(CASE WHEN c.created_at >= datetime() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS current, sum(CASE WHEN c.created_at < datetime() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS previous RETURN dimension AS status_channel, current, previous, current - previous AS delta ORDER BY abs(current - previous) DESC LIMIT 5

name: Occupancy Rate
description: Percentage of logged-in time that contact center agents spend actively handling customer interactions versus waiting in idle ready state.
business_rules: Measures active handling duration vs total shift availability duration.
High occupancy (>85-90%) indicates understaffing and agent burnout risk.
Low occupancy (<60%) indicates overstaffing or inefficient routing.
cypher_template: MATCH (c:Conversation)-[:HANDLED_BY]->(a:ContactCentreAgent) WHERE c.created_at IS NOT NULL AND c.ended_at IS NOT NULL RETURN a.display_name AS agent, count(c) AS handled_interactions, round(sum(duration.between(c.created_at, c.ended_at).seconds) / 3600.0, 2) AS total_handle_hours ORDER BY total_handle_hours DESC
diagnostic_template: MATCH (c:Conversation)-[:HANDLED_BY]->(a:ContactCentreAgent) WHERE c.created_at >= datetime() AND c.created_at < datetime() AND c.ended_at IS NOT NULL WITH a.display_name AS dimension, sum(CASE WHEN c.created_at >= datetime() THEN duration.between(c.created_at, c.ended_at).seconds ELSE 0 END) AS curr_secs, sum(CASE WHEN c.created_at < datetime() THEN duration.between(c.created_at, c.ended_at).seconds ELSE 0 END) AS prev_secs RETURN dimension AS agent, round(curr_secs / 3600.0, 2) AS current_handle_hours, round(prev_secs / 3600.0, 2) AS previous_handle_hours, round((curr_secs - prev_secs) / 3600.0, 2) AS hours_delta ORDER BY current_handle_hours DESC

name: Abandonment Rate & Missed Contacts
description: Percentage of customer interactions where the customer disconnected before being connected to an agent or where routing attempts timed out.
business_rules: Explicitly logged in (:MissedContact) nodes attached to (:Conversation).
Primary abandonment reasons in telemetry are no_agent_available and offer_timeout.
Customer-side disconnects feature end_actor = customer and end_reason = customer_ended while assigned_at IS NULL.
cypher_template: MATCH (m:MissedContact) RETURN m.reason AS missed_reason, coalesce(m.channel, "unknown") AS channel, count(m) AS incident_count ORDER BY incident_count DESC
diagnostic_template: MATCH (m:MissedContact) WHERE m.created_at >= datetime() AND m.created_at < datetime() WITH m.reason + " (" + coalesce(m.channel, "unknown") + ")" AS dimension, sum(CASE WHEN m.created_at >= datetime() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS current, sum(CASE WHEN m.created_at < datetime() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS previous RETURN dimension AS reason_channel, current, previous, current - previous AS delta ORDER BY abs(current - previous) DESC LIMIT 5

name: After-Call Work / Wrap-up Time (ACW)
description: Time spent by agents immediately following interaction disconnect to complete documentation, add internal work notes, and assign disposition codes.
business_rules: Documented via (:Conversation)-[:HAS]->(:InternalNote) authored by (:ContactCentreAgent).
Excessive wrap-up time increases queue wait times for subsequent callers.
cypher_template: MATCH (c:Conversation)-[:HAS]->(n:InternalNote) RETURN c.channel AS channel, count(n) AS notes_count, count(DISTINCT c) AS conversations_with_notes ORDER BY notes_count DESC
diagnostic_template: MATCH (c:Conversation)-[:HAS]->(n:InternalNote) WHERE c.created_at >= datetime() AND c.created_at < datetime() WITH c.channel AS dimension, sum(CASE WHEN c.created_at >= datetime() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS current_notes, sum(CASE WHEN c.created_at < datetime() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS previous_notes RETURN dimension AS channel, current_notes, previous_notes, current_notes - previous_notes AS delta ORDER BY current_notes DESC

name: Shrinkage
description: Percentage of scheduled agent shift time unavailable to handle customer interactions due to breaks, meetings, training, or unplanned absenteeism.
business_rules: Computed from planned shift hours vs active handling logged hours.
Break intervals configured in Shift: break_start_time, break_end_time.
cypher_template: MATCH (b:BusinessHours)-[:HAS]->(s:Shift) RETURN b.name AS business_hours, count(s) AS shifts, collect(DISTINCT s.start_time)[0..3] AS sample_start_times
diagnostic_template: MATCH (b:BusinessHours)-[:HAS]->(s:Shift) RETURN s.start_time AS start_time, s.end_time AS end_time, count(s) AS shift_count ORDER BY start_time ASC

name: Disconnect Reason & Actor Breakdown (The Disconnect Trinity)
description: Empirical diagnostic breakdown of interaction terminations across the three database telemetry fields: who ended it (actor), why it ended (reason), and agent outcome (disposition).
business_rules: end_actor values: customer, system, agent, session.
end_reason values: customer_ended, visitor_disconnected, idle_timeout, bot_resolved_inactivity, agent_completed, agent_declined, superseded_by_new_voice_call, forced_close.
disposition_code values: agent_declined, customer_disconnected, browser_disconnected.
cypher_template: MATCH (c:Conversation) WHERE c.end_actor IS NOT NULL RETURN c.end_actor AS actor, c.end_reason AS reason, c.disposition_code AS disposition, count(c) AS volume ORDER BY volume DESC
diagnostic_template: MATCH (c:Conversation) WHERE c.created_at >= datetime() AND c.created_at < datetime() AND c.end_actor IS NOT NULL WITH c.end_actor + " : " + coalesce(c.end_reason, "unknown") AS dimension, sum(CASE WHEN c.created_at >= datetime() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS current, sum(CASE WHEN c.created_at < datetime() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS previous RETURN dimension AS actor_reason, current, previous, current - previous AS delta, CASE WHEN previous > 0 THEN round(100.0 * (current - previous) / previous, 1) ELSE NULL END AS pct_change ORDER BY abs(current - previous) DESC LIMIT 5

name: Queue Wait Time & Average Speed to Answer (ASA)
description: Duration a customer interaction waits in a queue before being assigned to and answered by a live agent.
business_rules: Calculated as duration.between(c.queued_at, c.assigned_at).seconds.
Correlates with queue backlog and agent availability.
cypher_template: MATCH (c:Conversation)-[:ROUTED_TO]->(q:ContactCentreQueue) WHERE c.queued_at IS NOT NULL AND c.assigned_at IS NOT NULL RETURN q.name AS queue_name, count(c) AS routed_count, round(avg(duration.between(c.queued_at, c.assigned_at).seconds), 1) AS avg_wait_seconds, max(duration.between(c.queued_at, c.assigned_at).seconds) AS max_wait_seconds ORDER BY routed_count DESC
diagnostic_template: MATCH (c:Conversation)-[:ROUTED_TO]->(q:ContactCentreQueue) WHERE c.created_at >= datetime() AND c.created_at < datetime() AND c.queued_at IS NOT NULL AND c.assigned_at IS NOT NULL WITH q.name AS dimension, [x IN collect(CASE WHEN c.created_at >= datetime() THEN duration.between(c.queued_at, c.assigned_at).seconds ELSE NULL END) WHERE x IS NOT NULL] AS curr_waits, [x IN collect(CASE WHEN c.created_at < datetime() THEN duration.between(c.queued_at, c.assigned_at).seconds ELSE NULL END) WHERE x IS NOT NULL] AS prev_waits RETURN dimension AS queue, size(curr_waits) AS current_routed, CASE WHEN size(curr_waits) > 0 THEN round(reduce(s = 0.0, w IN curr_waits | s + w) / size(curr_waits), 1) ELSE 0.0 END AS current_avg_wait_sec, size(prev_waits) AS previous_routed, CASE WHEN size(prev_waits) > 0 THEN round(reduce(s = 0.0, w IN prev_waits | s + w) / size(prev_waits), 1) ELSE 0.0 END AS previous_avg_wait_sec, size(curr_waits) - size(prev_waits) AS volume_delta ORDER BY current_routed DESC

name: Agent Workload & Concurrency
description: Distribution of customer interactions handled, resolved, and currently active across contact center staff.
business_rules: Tracked via (:Conversation)-[:HANDLED_BY]->(a:ContactCentreAgent).
Agents identified by display_name and email.
Compare closed conversations vs total handled.
cypher_template: MATCH (c:Conversation)-[:HANDLED_BY]->(a:ContactCentreAgent) RETURN a.display_name AS agent_name, a.email AS email, count(c) AS handled_count, sum(CASE WHEN c.status = "closed" THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS closed_count, round(avg(duration.between(c.created_at, c.ended_at).seconds), 1) AS avg_handle_time_sec ORDER BY handled_count DESC
diagnostic_template: MATCH (c:Conversation)-[:HANDLED_BY]->(a:ContactCentreAgent) WHERE c.created_at >= datetime() AND c.created_at < datetime() WITH a.display_name AS dimension, sum(CASE WHEN c.created_at >= datetime() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS current_volume, sum(CASE WHEN c.created_at < datetime() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS previous_volume, round(avg(duration.between(c.created_at, c.ended_at).seconds), 1) AS aht_sec RETURN dimension AS agent, current_volume, previous_volume, current_volume - previous_volume AS delta, aht_sec ORDER BY current_volume DESC

name: Bot-to-Human Escalation & Failure Telemetry
description: Diagnoses interactions where the automated bot attempted to hand off to a human agent but failed due to unstaffed queues or timeout.
business_rules: c.facts contains empirical diagnostic tags: no_ready_agents, live_agent_unavailable, bot_continue.
c.handoff_reason indicates customer escalation request: User requested live agent.
c.summary provides machine routing event details.
cypher_template: MATCH (c:Conversation) WHERE any(f IN c.facts WHERE f IN ["no_ready_agents", "live_agent_unavailable"]) RETURN c.channel AS channel, c.handoff_reason AS handoff_reason, count(c) AS failed_handoffs, collect(DISTINCT c.summary)[0..3] AS sample_logs ORDER BY failed_handoffs DESC
diagnostic_template: MATCH (c:Conversation) WHERE c.created_at >= datetime() AND c.created_at < datetime()   AND any(f IN c.facts WHERE f IN ["no_ready_agents", "live_agent_unavailable"]) WITH c.channel + " (" + coalesce(c.handoff_reason, "unknown") + ")" AS dimension, sum(CASE WHEN c.created_at >= datetime() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS current, sum(CASE WHEN c.created_at < datetime() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS previous RETURN dimension AS handoff_incident, current, previous, current - previous AS delta ORDER BY abs(current - previous) DESC LIMIT 5

name: Transfer Loops & Journey Continuations
description: Identifies customer interactions that were bounced between multiple queues or agents across sequential threads.
business_rules: Tracked via (:Conversation)-[:CONTINUES]->(:Conversation) and (:Conversation)-[:HAS]->(:Transfer).
Multi-hop continuations highlight severe routing failure and customer friction.
cypher_template: MATCH (c1:Conversation)-[:CONTINUES]->(c2:Conversation) RETURN c1.channel AS source_channel, c2.channel AS target_channel, count(*) AS continuation_volume ORDER BY continuation_volume DESC
diagnostic_template: MATCH (c1:Conversation)-[:CONTINUES]->(c2:Conversation) WHERE c1.created_at >= datetime() AND c1.created_at < datetime() WITH c1.channel + " -> " + c2.channel AS dimension, sum(CASE WHEN c1.created_at >= datetime() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS current_hops, sum(CASE WHEN c1.created_at < datetime() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS previous_hops RETURN dimension AS channel_flow, current_hops, previous_hops, current_hops - previous_hops AS delta ORDER BY abs(current_hops - previous_hops) DESC LIMIT 5

name: Shift Coverage & Business Hours Adherence
description: Correlates interaction volumes and abandonment spikes with operational shifts and business operating schedules.
business_rules: Operating hours defined in (:BusinessHours)-[:HAS]->(:Shift).
Shifts in Asia/Kolkata: Morning (06:00-14:00), Evening (14:00-22:00), Night (22:00-06:00).
High after-hours traffic indicates need for expanded shift coverage or enhanced bot self-service.
cypher_template: MATCH (b:BusinessHours)-[:HAS]->(s:Shift) RETURN b.name AS calendar_name, b.timezone AS timezone, count(s) AS total_shifts
diagnostic_template: MATCH (c:Conversation) WHERE c.created_at >= datetime() AND c.created_at < datetime() WITH substring(toString(c.created_at), 11, 2) AS dimension, sum(CASE WHEN c.created_at >= datetime() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS current_volume, sum(CASE WHEN c.created_at < datetime() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS previous_volume, sum(CASE WHEN c.created_at >= datetime() AND c.end_reason = "customer_ended" AND c.assigned_at IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS curr_abandoned RETURN dimension AS hour_utc, current_volume, previous_volume, current_volume - previous_volume AS delta, curr_abandoned AS abandoned_in_current_period ORDER BY current_volume DESC LIMIT 6
